cases.name: path-routing
cases.goal: First read src/normalize.rs and src/route.rs and run the existing feedback tests, then repair both modules while preserving their public APIs. canonical_path ignores empty slash-separated segments and returns one leading slash and no trailing slash; an empty path is '/'. Preserve every nonempty segment exactly, including Unicode and case. Do not resolve dots, decode escapes or interpret queries. matches_route canonicalizes both inputs and matches a whole segment prefix: '/api' matches '/api' and '/api/users', but not '/apiary'. The root '/' matches every path.
